topics.text: Rooms are spacious, with many featuring large balconies offering great views. The beds are comfortable, and bathrooms often include large bathtubs. Facilities such as clean linens, smart devices, and complete amenities ensure a pleasant stay.
The staff is frequently praised for their friendliness and efficiency. Check-in and check-out processes are smooth, and service is generally attentive, with responsive assistance to guest needs.
Rooms and common areas are consistently noted for their cleanliness. Housekeeping maintains high standards, ensuring that rooms are tidy and well-kept throughout the stay.

Many guests find the hotel to offer good value for the price, especially given the facilities and service quality. The overall experience is often described as exceeding expectations compared to similar-priced accommodations.

address: No. 99, He Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
